description: Valid mono and stereo frames, among them some that break the specification without stopping the reading: an ics_reserved_bit of 1, ms_mask_present 3, pulse data in short windows, a scalefactor of 270, a TNS filter of order 15 and fill bytes of 0x55.
findings: pulse data in eight short windows
a TNS filter of a higher order than the 12 its window allows
fill data other than the fill nibble 0000 and fill bytes 10100101

skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg rejects some of the frames.
skip.faad: faad2 rejects some of the frames.
skip.decode: decoders reject some of the frames
skip.faad_trace: faad2 stops at frames it rejects.
